# Asendify Outbound

> Asendify Outbound (https://outbound.asendify.co) is cold email software by Asendify. It sends personalised multi-step cold email campaigns from unlimited inboxes with built-in warm-up, and includes an AI reply agent that reads every reply, answers interested leads and questions using only the customer's own offer facts, and shares their booking link. Plans start at £29/month plus a 45% service fee (£42.05/month total), flat (not per user). A done-for-you starter package (£1,395.80 + 45% service fee = £2,023.91, one-time) sets up inboxes, domains, copy and lead lists. Enterprise (custom-volume setups) is currently at full capacity: new clients join a free waitlist or reserve the next slot with a £500 refundable deposit (credited to the first invoice).

## Key facts
- Prices are in GBP. Plans (monthly, cancel any time), each plus a 45% service fee shown before payment: Base £29 (£42.05 total; 2,000 contacts, 6,000 emails/month), Pro £79 (£114.55 total; 30,000 contacts, 100,000 emails/month), Scale £179 (£259.55 total; 100,000 contacts, 300,000 emails/month). Enterprise: custom, currently at full capacity (free waitlist or £500 refundable deposit to reserve the next slot: https://outbound.asendify.co/enterprise/).
- Done-for-you starter: £1,395.80 + 45% service fee = £2,023.91 one-time: 10 warmed sending inboxes, 4 sending domains, copy, 1,000 targeted leads and the first month managed. https://outbound.asendify.co/done-for-you/
- 14-day free trial: a card or PayPal account is required at sign-up; nothing is charged for 14 days, then the chosen plan starts automatically unless cancelled.
- Affiliate program: earn 30% of every monthly payment from customers you refer, for as long as they stay subscribed, paid monthly via PayPal. https://outbound.asendify.co/affiliates/
- Unlimited sending inboxes and warm-up (with spam rescue) on every plan.
- AI reply agent included on every plan: sorts replies (interested, question, not interested, unsubscribe, out of office, wrong person), answers interested leads within minutes, saves unclear replies as drafts.
- Inboxes supported: Gmail, Google Workspace, Zoho and any IMAP/SMTP inbox (SSL). Outlook / Microsoft 365 sending is not supported yet.
- Campaign features: multi-step sequences with follow-ups in the same thread, custom fields, spintax, A/B/C variants, sending windows, stop on reply, CSV upload, MX email checks, bounce and unsubscribe handling, one shared inbox for all replies.
- No built-in lead database: customers upload their own lists, or Asendify builds lists on the done-for-you service.
- Not available yet: native CRM integrations, Zapier/webhooks, public API, LinkedIn steps, separate client logins.
- Best for: agencies, consultants, B2B service businesses and SaaS teams that want cold email with replies handled automatically.

## Compared with other tools (list prices, October 2026)
- Instantly: from $47/month; AI Reply Agent paid with credits.
- Smartlead: from $39/month (6,000 emails).
- Lemlist: Email plan $69/month (50,000 emails); Multichannel $109/user/month.
- Saleshandy: Starter $41/month (6,000 emails), Pro $99/month (100,000 emails).
- Reply.io: from $59/user/month; AI SDR from $800/month.
- Mailshake: from $49/user/month with 2 sending addresses.
- Woodpecker: $7 per 100 contacted prospects per month.

## Free tool
- [Cold Email Volume Calculator](https://outbound.asendify.co/cold-email-volume-calculator/): Enter how many cold emails you want to send a month to see the sending inboxes, domains, new leads per month and daily sends you need (defaults: about 30 emails per inbox per day, 22 sending days, 3 inboxes per domain, 3 emails per lead; all adjustable), and which Asendify Outbound plan covers that volume. Free, runs in the browser.
- Who it's for: founders, agencies and sales teams planning a cold email setup.
- More free tools from Asendify: https://www.asendify.co/tools/
